fields.description: Which registered handler answers for this — `record.save`, `task`, `calendar.event`. Data rather than Select: the list is a registry an app adds to, and a Select would mean a schema change per kind.
fields.label: Kind

fields.description: One line, written by the handler rather than by the model: what the card says has to be what the row does.
fields.label: Summary

fields.description: What was made, once it exists. A created record needs it; an updated one already had a name.
fields.label: Applied Name

fields.description: What this was suggested *from* — the conversation, the document, the record somebody was looking at. How a surface finds the cards that belong on it.
fields.label: About Doctype

fields.description: Empty unless the assistant asked for it. Mail and the editors have no session and do not invent one.
fields.label: Session

fields.description: The last stored turn when this was proposed. What the chat panel hangs the card under: everything a run proposes belongs to the answer that run gave.
fields.label: After Message

fields.description: The handler's own arguments, as it will be applied.
fields.label: Payload

fields.description: What the handler read before proposing, where there was anything to read. Apply compares against it and refuses where it has moved, so a stale proposal is a refusal rather than a silent overwrite.
fields.label: Before
